description: Fetch an RSS or Atom feed and return normalized JSON items: title, link, publication date (ISO) and summary. Server-side fetching with SSRF guard; handles both RSS 2.0 and Atom dialects. Use this when an agent needs to any feed → clean JSON items, no XML parsing on your side. x402 price $0.002/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: dev_feed_parser
title: RSS / Atom Feed Parser
